_source: DOMINION D7 (Evil Mode rework): the Founding at Street Gang (Part 9 A15), the armband rule (Part 6 §8, Part 11), the fourteen Goals (Kice's evil_mode_goals.zip, Parts 35a-35c: name, one line, motto quote). Text is data. Names taken by canon teams and the old Evil Mode come from src/data/evilMode/founding.json.

ideas: Ask once. Then we ask again.

goals.name: Total Takeover
goals.line: Own every lever in the region, with a fist or a mask.
goals.quote: Everything in this region belongs to someone. It should belong to us.

goals.name: Land Preservation
goals.line: Take the world back from people, for the land or the sea.
goals.quote: People took the world from the Pokémon. We're taking it back.

goals.name: A New Perfect Order
goals.line: The world's flawed. Remake it without spirit, or without the unworthy.
goals.quote: The world is flawed. We have the means to correct it.

goals.name: Herald of Legends
goals.line: A golden prophecy says something's coming. Be there when it arrives.
goals.quote: It's written in gold: something's coming. We'll be there to meet it.

goals.name: Ultra Divinity
goals.line: The Ultra Beasts are evolution's summit, and you'll prove it.
goals.quote: They came from beyond the sky, perfect. We're the rough draft.

goals.name: Spores of Creation
goals.line: Paras can bond with people. Everyone should be one. If they'll say yes.
goals.quote: Paras doesn't carry the mushroom. They're one thing. We could be one thing too.

goals.name: Pure Hate
goals.line: Hate everyone. Spread it. See what's left.
goals.quote: I hate all of you. I want you to know how it feels.

goals.name: Every Ball Opened
goals.line: Free every Pokémon from every trainer. You mean it.
goals.quote: No Pokémon chose its Ball. Every one of them deserves the chance.

goals.name: Endless Energy
goals.line: The world runs out of power in a thousand years. Fix it now, whatever it costs.
goals.quote: In a thousand years the lights go out. I'm the only one who's done the sum.

goals.name: Everlasting
goals.line: You're going to die. You've decided not to.
goals.quote: Everything I love ends. I've decided I won't.

goals.name: Every Window
goals.line: Put a Rotom in every machine, and see everything.
goals.quote: If I can see everything, nothing can surprise me again.

goals.name: The Rightful Crown
goals.line: The region had a king once. You're the heir.
goals.quote: This region had a king. The line didn't end. It's me.

goals.name: Apex
goals.line: Strength is the only true thing. Make the strongest there's ever been.
goals.quote: Strength is the only thing that's never lied to me.

goals.name: Clean Slate
goals.line: The region carries a terrible memory. Make it forget.
goals.quote: Something terrible happened here. If nobody remembers it, it never has to hurt again.

noGoal.name: Rule
noGoal.line: No special Goal: win by taking the region (Wipe Out, Shadow or Monarch).
noGoal.quote: We don't need a reason. We need the region.

lines.ready: The town says your name now, quietly. Time for the Founding: a name, colours, a mark and a motto.
lines.later: The Founding can wait. It's on the HQ when you're ready (O).
lines.notYet: Not yet: both First Steps done and Street Gang on the Notoriety ladder.
lines.short: Too short: at least two letters.
lines.taken: {name} is already a team. Pick your own.
lines.motto: The motto is {max} letters at most.

said.grunt: ...Huh. It's on the door now. That's real, then.
said.admin: A name on the door. Good. Now they'll know whose door it is.

scene: Somebody's painted it on the warehouse door overnight: {name}.
{member} turns the new armband over twice, then ties it on. {colours}.
